title: A Dangerous Game (FCP 2026)
synopsis:
In a summer villa, a couple married for twenty years invite an enigmatic young woman. Desire, jealousy and things left unsaid give way to a dangerous game in which each plays a part. Their children, watching from afar, grow uneasy: who is playing with whom? Is their mother in danger?

 

Q/A with the co-screenwriter Alma Brami, author of the original novel "Qui ne dit mot consent" on 25 NOVEMBER at MOViE MOViE Pacific Place.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
一對結婚二十年的夫婦，在避暑別墅接待一位神秘的年輕女子。慾望、嫉妒，還有那些沒說出口的話，交織在一起，一場危險的遊戲就此拉開序幕，每個人都被捲了進去。他們的子女在遠方默默看在眼裡，越來越感到不安: 到底誰在算計誰? 母親會不會有危險?

 

11月25日 MOViE MOViE Pacific Place 場次放映後將設有編劇兼原著小說Qui ne dit mot consent作者 Alma Brami的問答環節。
